findings.detail: Rows with N/A(6) interest still disclose a floating-rate spread, so basis_spread should not be blank even when interest_rate is not stated.
The Any Hour row discloses a 13.00% PIK interest term, but the extracted interest_rate is blank.

rationale: Class 2 row-level adjudication. The flag says the affected private-credit rows have no extracted interest_rate or basis_spread. Raw source rows for the flagged issuers show the rate columns are populated: several commitment/negative-cost rows have a spread above index such as SF + 4.50%, SF + 4.75%, SF + 5.00%, or SF + 5.50% while interest is N/A(6), and the Any Hour row explicitly shows 13.00% PIK. Because source provides rate terms that the extraction omitted, the X02 warning is a real data error caused by an extraction gap.
